note: Established shops that sell Pokémon TCG singles to Canadian collectors, with each shop's published shipping policy. Collected by reading the shops' public policy pages; no inventory is scraped. Rates a shop only shows at checkout are left out.

stores.name: 401 Games
stores.summary: Singles-only orders: $3 untracked lettermail, free lettermail from $30, free expedited from $100 (singles) or $175.

stores.name: Danireon Cards & Games
stores.summary: Untracked bubble mailers and tracked options; rates shown at checkout. Optional shipping insurance. Ships in up to 7 business days.

stores.name: Face to Face Games
stores.summary: Untracked first-class mail for small orders (rate at checkout); free expedited on Canadian orders $200+.

stores.name: Fusion Gaming
stores.summary: Singles-only untracked letter mail and Canada Post Standard; rates shown at checkout.

stores.name: Hobbiesville
stores.summary: Canada Post; free on orders $175+. Paid rates shown at checkout.

stores.name: Rémi Card Trader
stores.summary: Tracked, $15 flat in Canada ($100 to the territories); free from $175. Ships within 1 business day.

stores.name: Untouchables Comics, Cards & Games
stores.summary: $11.95 Canada Post Expedited (tracked), no lettermail option; free from $200 before tax.

stores.name: Poké Jeux
stores.summary: Pokémon specialist in Boucherville. Untracked letter mail or tracked shipping (rates at checkout); free UPS on $200+ before tax.

stores.name: Deck Out Gaming
stores.summary: Tracked parcel $14.99 under $60, $11.99 for $60–$249.99, free from $250. Untracked bubble mailer also offered.

stores.name: KanZen Games
stores.summary: Singles: $1.49 letter mail, $2.89 bubble mail (up to 17 cards), $4.98 (up to 30), all untracked. Free on $300+.

stores.name: GameKnight Games
stores.summary: Singles-only orders: $3 flat untracked letter mail; free (expedited) from $200 before tax.

stores.name: CoolStuffInc
stores.summary: US store that ships to Canada; international rates quoted at checkout, customs handled case by case. ($2.99 singles / free over $30 applies to the US only.)
